question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/076c1153eb4c3da254ab68ac77b4806888ebb6566400864bf74a663f4e75556d.png]
solution:
The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below:

1) Total triangles = Number of parts × Number of diagonals

= 2 × 1 ⇒ 2
